description: This is a shell script that automates building, testing, and coverage analysis of an embedded software project. It manages dependencies, checks out repositories, applies patches, builds components with coverage flags, runs tests, and generates coverage reports for the AppGateway plugin and associated components.
published: Main functions for orchestrating repository setup, build, testing, and coverage analysis

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the environment.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Determines if the current user has root privileges.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Checks if apt-get can be run (i.e., if the environment is root or has sudo).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get with necessary options to install packages.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs commands individually, logging non-fatal failures.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for non-interactive git operation.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref/tag in a given repository directory.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if needed, optionally force-reclones, then checks out a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository, silently tolerating already-applied patches.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks whether a build directory has a CMake cache, indicating a configured build.

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristically checks if a component is installed based on directory contents.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a CMake project with verbose logging.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a CMake project without installation step.
